row.title: MECH-FIX-1: mechanical findings are fixed by code, with no model call
row.body: Measured 2026-11-20 in ops/executor-log.jsonl on loop-evidence: 12 of 12 model attempts on Q-SELF-unused-import items failed because the model re-emits the whole file and breaks it, and none of the 14 current findings is a false positive. foundation/mechfix.py computes the edit from the syntax tree (names another file reaches through the module are left alone) and foundation/executor.py asks it before the model ladder, so these items need no model credential and no AI budget. The change still passes the scope check, targeted checks, write-back, pull request and merge lane.
